mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_match_result (company_profile_id, incident_id, similarity_score, match_reason) VALUES (#{companyProfileId}, #{incidentId}, #{similarityScore}, #{matchReason}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT id, company_profile_id, incident_id, similarity_score, match_reason::text AS match_reason, generated_at, expires_at FROM safety_match_result WHERE company_profile_id = #{companyProfileId} AND expires_at > now() ORDER BY similarity_score DESC, generated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM safety_match_result WHERE expires_at <= now()
